# SCI-POINT Known-Source Applicability Facts

Identity: `SCI-POINT_APPLICABILITY_FACTS v0.1/r0.3`

| Fact | Exact scientific meaning | Current numerical test state |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `known` | exact source identity and authoritative expected-position record are available and valid for the observation | instance-dependent; unavailable when either authority is missing |
| `isolated` | exact source-environment/association authority supports the selected search and fit domains against confusing sources or structure | threshold/test unavailable pending compatibility-method authority |
| `bright` | source belongs to one exact compatibility-method applicability class; it is not inferred from statistical significance, dynamic range, or formal standardization | class/test unavailable pending compatibility-method authority |
| `approximately_centered` | exact declared relation among expected position, search domain, fit domain, parent support, and map boundary is satisfied | relation/threshold unavailable pending compatibility-method authority |

Each fact carries value/state, method/authority, domain, cause, validity,
lifecycle, and provenance. No observing-mode label, filename, implementation
default, map finiteness, fitted amplitude, or diagnostic ratio instantiates a
fact. Applicability is evaluated separately from named-use eligibility and
producer realization.
